## Decisions
- Prompts are file-backed from `benchmarks/*.md`; adding/changing files appears after page reload or Refresh.
- Prepared run prompts are snapshots written to each run folder as `prompt.md`; changing benchmark files affects future runs, not existing run folders.
- Model lists are not hardcoded in production UI:
  - live models come from LM Studio `/v1/models`
  - historical run models come from `runs/**/metadata.json`
  - sync status comes from Pi/OpenCode config files
- Static exports are generated snapshots and must be regenerated after prompt/run changes.
- Write actions must remain dev-server only by default.
